questions.subject: Physics
questions.prompt: A car speeds up uniformly from 18 km/h to 36 km/h in 5 s. Its acceleration in m/s²?
questions.hint: Divide km/h by 3.6 to get m/s.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.prompt: Resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω and 6 Ω are connected in PARALLEL. The equivalent resistance in Ω?
questions.explanation: 1/R = 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/6 = 1, so R = 1 Ω. In parallel the total is smaller than the smallest resistor.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.prompt: A 1000 W heater runs 2 hours a day for 30 days. How many units (kWh) of electricity does it use?
questions.explanation: 1000 W = 1 kW. Energy = 1 kW × 2 h × 30 = 60 kWh = 60 units.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.prompt: An object is placed at 2F in front of a CONVEX lens. The image is...

options: real, inverted, same size, at 2F on the other side

questions.explanation: At 2F the image forms at 2F on the other side: real, inverted and the same size as the object.
questions.hint: 2F is the mirror point of a convex lens.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.prompt: A lens has a focal length of -25 cm. Its power in dioptres?
questions.explanation: f = -0.25 m, so P = 1 / (-0.25) = -4 D. The minus sign means a concave (diverging) lens.
questions.hint: Change cm to metres first, and keep the sign.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.prompt: A stone is dropped from rest from a 45 m tall tower (g = 10 m/s²). How many seconds until it hits the ground?
questions.explanation: 45 = ½ × 10 × t², so t² = 9 and t = 3 s.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.prompt: A ray of light passes from air into glass and bends TOWARDS the normal. Why?

options: Glass reflects part of the light

questions.explanation: Glass is optically denser: light travels slower in it, so it bends towards the normal.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.prompt: A 20 kg box is lifted 5 m straight up (g = 10 m/s²). Work done against gravity, in joules?

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: Fe₂O₃ + 2Al → Al₂O₃ + 2Fe is an example of a...
questions.explanation: Aluminium is more reactive than iron, so it displaces iron from its oxide (the thermite reaction). It is also a redox reaction.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: How many moles of water molecules are there in 36 g of water? (H = 1, O = 16)
questions.explanation: Molar mass of H₂O = 2 + 16 = 18 g/mol. Moles = 36 / 18 = 2 mol.
questions.hint: Find the molar mass of H₂O.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: Zinc reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid. Name the gas given off.
questions.explanation: Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂. Metals more reactive than hydrogen release hydrogen gas from dilute acids.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: A solution turns blue litmus RED. Its pH is most likely...
questions.explanation: Acids turn blue litmus red, and acids have a pH below 7.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: Write the chemical formula of baking soda.
questions.explanation: Baking soda is sodium hydrogen carbonate, NaHCO₃.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: In CuO + H₂ → Cu + H₂O, which substance is the OXIDISING agent?
questions.explanation: CuO gives its oxygen to hydrogen, oxidising it, so CuO is the oxidising agent (and is itself reduced to Cu).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: Chlorine has atomic number 17. How many electrons are in its OUTERMOST shell?
questions.explanation: 2, 8, 7: chlorine has 7 valence electrons, so it gains one to complete its octet.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: The functional group in ethanoic acid (CH₃COOH) is...
questions.explanation: -COOH is the carboxylic acid group, which makes ethanoic acid (vinegar) acidic.
questions.hint: The name ends in oic acid.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.prompt: Coating iron with a thin layer of zinc to stop rusting is called...?
questions.explanation: Galvanisation: zinc protects iron even if scratched, because zinc corrodes first.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: Which blood vessel carries OXYGENATED blood from the lungs to the heart?
questions.explanation: The pulmonary vein is the exception: a vein that carries oxygenated blood, from the lungs to the left atrium.
questions.hint: It is the one vein that breaks the rule.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: Name the structural and functional unit of the kidney.
questions.explanation: Each kidney has about a million nephrons, which filter the blood and make urine.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: Which hormone is called the emergency hormone (fight or flight)?
questions.explanation: Adrenaline, from the adrenal glands, raises heart rate and breathing to prepare the body for an emergency.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: The tiny gap between two neurons, where the message crosses as a chemical, is called the...?
questions.explanation: At the synapse the electrical signal becomes a chemical (neurotransmitter) that crosses to the next neuron.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: Yeast respires WITHOUT oxygen. The products are...
questions.explanation: Anaerobic respiration (fermentation) in yeast makes ethanol and CO₂. Lactic acid is made in our muscles instead.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: Two tall pea plants, both Tt, are crossed. What PERCENTAGE of the offspring will be short (tt)?

givens: draw the Punnett square: TT, Tt, Tt, tt

questions.explanation: Tt × Tt gives TT : Tt : tt = 1 : 2 : 1, so 1 in 4 = 25% are short.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: Which part of the brain keeps your posture and balance?
questions.explanation: The cerebellum (hind brain) coordinates movement, posture and balance.
questions.hint: The little brain at the back.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: Name the enzyme in saliva that starts digesting starch.
questions.explanation: Salivary amylase (ptyalin) breaks starch into sugar, which is why bread tastes sweet if you chew it long.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.prompt: Photosynthesis takes place in which part of a plant cell?
questions.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which traps sunlight to make glucose from CO₂ and water.
